messages.author: 8a8f3a98a7f003ac
messages.subject: density surface error? - Activity Centres of Detected and Undetected Animals
parts:
Hello,


I am having an issue with plotting activity centers for my secr.fit model. I have been using this script (excerpt only):


fed_secrPoly50 <- secr.fit(fedCH15, mask = 'feMASKpoly50',model = g0 ~ 1, trace = TRUE)

fedDen <- fx.total(fed_secrPoly50)

plot(fedDen,covariate = 'D.sum', col=terrain.colors(16), plottype='shaded')


I successfully ran this script several other times (for other sites) and produced the density map I am trying to get. I have no errors or warnings in my full script, so I have no idea what is going on. I even rotated the mask and capthist because of east-west concavity issues – no difference. 


Any ideas on what is going on here?


Thanks, 

Nik

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: density surface error? - Activity Centres of Detected and Undetected Animals
parts:
Nik


Your question does not concern density surfaces - these are something else (please read the Note on the fx.total help, and secr-densitysurfaces.pdf). I mention this because the misuse of 'density surface' is becoming a problem in the literature.


I presume the problem you see is that the computed surface is (almost) flat. Others who have more enthusiasm for and experience with fx.total may recognise the problem - I don't really have a clue. I suggest you take a good hard look at the fitted model itself (extreme estimates or missing variances would indicate a problem).


Murray
